dates: 2010 to July 2025: written from memory of the central banks' published calendars, because the build sandbox cannot reach ecb.europa.eu or boj.or.jp (not checked against them). August 2025 on: copied from council/events.mjs (RAW.ECB, RAW.BOJ), which was checked against the official pages. Where to check: ECB Governing Council monetary policy meeting calendar and the press releases of each date (ecb.europa.eu/press/calendars/mgcgc/html/index.en.html, ecb.europa.eu/press/pr/html/index.en.html); Bank of Japan Monetary Policy Meeting schedule and the statements on monetary policy of each meeting (boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/index.htm, boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmdeci/state_all/index.htm).
scope: A new stand-alone event rule on EUR/USD and USD/JPY; not a test of the gold book (owner decision item 44 untouched).
rule: direction of the first 60 minutes after the decision (close of the M5 candle ending at D + 60 min against the one ending at D); entry at D + 60 min in that direction, stop 1 x the 14-hour ATR known at D, no target, out at 21:00 UTC (ECB) / 15:00 UTC (BoJ). D: ECB the larger-range candle of 13:45 / 14:15 Frankfurt; BoJ the first M5 candle from 03:00 UTC with a range above 2x the median of that hour on the 20 previous weekdays (none before 05:00 UTC: no trade)
costs: per round trip 0.3 pip spread + 0.3 pip slippage + 45 USD per million notional commission (0.0045 % of the price)
